lauren: Quick sync 1: I'm proposing a compact 'mini-eval' example for /optimize that walks through: SDK snippet -> batching settings -> KV/prefix cache impact -> short quant profile guidance. The aim is one runnable example devs can copy into CI. Who wants to own the code + perf table?

mike: I can write the Python SDK snippet and push a branch (docs/mini-eval-compact). Keep it under ~20 lines and add inline comments for each option.

anjali: Ill run a quick sweep (seq len 32 vs 256) on rw-opt-quant-8b with int8 and fp16 and paste a tiny table with latency + token-cost so folks can reproduce.

lauren: Also add a 2-line migration note for legacy batch_* keys referencing the migration guide.

sam: Found a stale link in /optimize/batching to the old quant-policy doc. Ill include a redirect and mention in the PR.

jessica: PR checklist: examples/optimize/mini_eval_compact.py, examples/tests/test_mini_eval_compact.py (mocked smoke test), update nav.yml, add a 2-bullet Recommendations section (cache vs batch), and a 1-paragraph note about safe fallback when quant shows regression.

mike: Draft snippet (will add as code block in PR):

```python
# examples/optimize/mini_eval_compact.py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
# pick int8 for throughput; choose fp16 when quality matters
quant_profile = {"preferred_dtype": "int8"}
resp = client.generate(
    model="rw-opt-quant-8b",
    input="Summarize in two bullets:\n- long user query\n",
    batch_options={"max_batch_latency_ms": 20, "max_batch_size": 8},
    cache={"kv_prefetch": True},
    quant_profile=quant_profile,
)
print(resp.text)
```

anjali: I'll post results like: "seq32 int8: 105ms / 0.043 tokens; seq256 int8: 372ms / 0.17 tokens; seq256 fp16: 418ms / 0.20 tokens" once runs complete. Will include the small token-cost math.

lauren: Recommendations (2 bullets):
- Use KV/prefix cache when many requests share prefixes 1 (low-latency wins, cost savings).
- Use larger batches when throughput bursts are acceptable and latency budget allows.
(Keep wording non-prescriptive.)

sam: I'll patch the stale link and add a one-liner to the PR description about the redirect.

jessica: Infra note: docs CI is CPU-only (no GPUs). Make sure tests mock the model call and use pytest markers.

infra-bot: Reminder: mark tests as cpu-only and mock network/model calls for docs CI.
